Beginner.learningGoal: Use find, match, gmatch and gsub with simple patterns and captures.
gotchas: Lua patterns are not regex: no alternation and - is lazy repetition
string.find returns indices, match returns captures
goodSolutionShows: gsub with a function or table replacement
shapeHints: extracting key=value pairs from a config line

Intermediate.learningGoal: Apply captures, anchors, frontier patterns and replacement functions.
gotchas: gsub returns two values (string, count), so wrapping in parentheses matters when passing on
An empty-match pattern in gmatch advances differently across versions
goodSolutionShows: Using only the first return value when needed
shapeHints: parsing a log line into fields

Advanced.learningGoal: Write robust tokenisers and parsers using patterns and position tracking.
gotchas: Patterns have no alternation, so alternatives need multiple passes
Backtracking can be exponential with nested repetition
shapeHints: a keymap string parser such as '<C-w>j' into parts
